memos.scout:
The case for buying is weak, and I don't think it clears the bar.

The strongest point is the classification: ORGANIC, with no airdrop dump, a low top-3 holder share (9.5%), and a modest bundle share (13%). Its last 15 minutes were net positive in SOL flow (+4.83 SOL) with a +24.5% return and 67 new buyers, so some demand is present right now.

But the rest of the brief undercuts it. The coin is down 80% from its 30-minute high and 79.7% over 30 minutes. Sellers (76) outnumber recent buyers (67), and sold SOL (41.06) is close to bought SOL (45.9), so the recent bounce looks like absorption of sellers rather than fresh conviction. Early post-graduation flow was also sell-heavy (sell-to-buy ratio 1.19), and a launch bot was present. Pool depth of 36 SOL means a $20 round trip faces meaningful slippage.

Real demand that persists for 30-60 minutes would show up as rising buyer counts against stable or falling sellers, and this brief doesn't show that. I'd skip it.
